content.user_title: Plan SKILL.md Releases and Distribution Packages
content.value_statement: Preparing skill releases requires consistent metadata, version history, and clean package contents. This documentation guide outlines a reviewable workflow, but does not include executable publishing tools.
actual_capabilities: Describes validation checks for YAML frontmatter, naming conventions, and internal links.
Outlines semantic version changes and coordinated changelog updates.
Documents clean ZIP packaging that excludes Git metadata and Python cache folders.
Describes GitHub-ready directory layouts and platform-specific metadata preparation.
Provides a dry-run example with a proposed patch release and an explicit approval step.
limitations: This folder contains only SKILL.md; scripts, extension source, templates, and the CLI implementation are absent.
Automated validation, version changes, and archive creation cannot be verified or performed by this package alone.
The described helper scripts require Python 3.x and are limited to SKILL.md project structures.
The documented workflow does not automatically upload releases or guarantee marketplace acceptance.

use_cases.title: Prepare a first skill release
use_cases.description: Create a release checklist covering frontmatter, naming, internal links, and package exclusions before preparing a marketplace submission.

use_cases.title: Coordinate a maintenance update
use_cases.description: Plan a patch version change and changelog entry with an approval checkpoint before modifying release files.

use_cases.title: Standardize release requirements
use_cases.description: Use the documented workflow as requirements for separately implemented validation and packaging tools across a team.

prompt_templates.title: Understand the release checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Summarize the documented checks for a first SKILL.md release. Identify which steps require tools missing from this package.

prompt_templates.title: Review supplied skill files
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my supplied SKILL.md and directory listing for frontmatter, naming, internal links, and packaging exclusions. Report missing evidence without changing files.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a patch release
prompt_templates.prompt: Using my supplied metadata, plan a patch release for a regex fix. Draft the changelog and package checklist; request approval before edits.

prompt_templates.title: Design a reproducible release workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a dry-run-first workflow for our SKILL.md repository. Separate documented requirements from missing tooling, and specify approval gates, validation checks, and packaging exclusions.

output_examples.input: What can I use directly from this public package?
output: Available: a guide covering validation, versioning, packaging, and metadata preparation.
Not included: helper scripts, extension source, templates, or a runnable CLI.
Use the guide for planning; obtain and review separate tools before expecting automation.

output_examples.input: Plan a patch release from 0.1.0 for a regex fix without changing files.
output: Proposed changelog entry: Fixed regex for edge-case parsing.
Package plan: exclude Git metadata and Python cache folders.
Status: proposal only; no validation executed or archive created.

best_practices: Confirm which executable tools are available before requesting automated release actions.
Review proposed version changes, changelog entries, and package contents before approving writes.
Check current destination registry requirements independently before submitting a release.
anti_patterns: Assuming the public guide includes the advertised scripts or CLI binary.
Treating an illustrative dry-run result as proof that validation or packaging actually occurred.
Publishing an archive without reviewing excluded files, metadata, and the intended version.

faq.question: Does this package include a working CLI?
faq.answer: No. The public folder contains only SKILL.md and explicitly excludes scripts, extension source, and templates.

faq.question: Can I use this guide with Claude, Codex, or Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes, it provides SKILL.md guidance for compatible agents. Actual automation requires separately available tools.

faq.question: What validation checks does the guide describe?
faq.answer: It describes YAML frontmatter checks, naming conventions, and broken internal links. No executable validator is included.

faq.question: Does it upload releases to marketplaces?
faq.answer: No. The documented workflow prepares local distribution materials and leaves uploads outside its stated scope.

faq.question: How should version changes be handled?
faq.answer: The guide describes semantic version bumps with changelog updates. Review a proposed change before approving any file modifications.

faq.question: Is Python required to read the guide?
faq.answer: No. Python 3.x is listed for the described helper scripts, which are not included in this public package.
